jobs.occupation: R&D Engineer with Supply Chain Focus
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Are you an experienced design engineer looking for a new challenge beyond traditional R&D work?
In this role, you will be the technical link between R&D, our suppliers, and the supply chain organization. You will use your engineering background to support supplier qualifications, contribute to technical discussions on manufacturing solutions, and ensure that our design requirements are understood and fulfilled.
This is a new role with opportunities to influence and shape how we work. With suppliers located around the world, international travel will be a natural part of your work.
How You'll Make an Impact
Represent R&D in technical discussions and qualifications of new and existing suppliers.
Review and clarify technical requirements, drawings, and specifications together with suppliers and manufacturing teams.
Support technical evaluations and assessments of supplier capabilities.
Provide engineering support to Procurement, Supplier Quality, and internal manufacturing operations.
Contribute to improvements in component design, manufacturing processes, and supplier qualification methods.

What You Bring
A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience in mechanical design and product development within R&D.
Experience working with 3D CAD, technical drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
Good understanding of manufacturing processes and technical requirements.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across different technical disciplines.
Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.
Experience with manufacturing processes such as precision casting, machining, brazing, or coating is considered an advantage.

We Believe You Are
A curious and proactive engineer who enjoys working with people and exploring new technical challenges. You are comfortable taking responsibility, sharing your expertise, and building strong relationships with colleagues and suppliers. You enjoy combining engineering knowledge with a broader perspective on how components are manufactured and delivered.
About the Team
You will join our Turbine R&D team, responsible for the design and development of hot gas path components, including turbine blades and guide vanes, as well as turbine rotors for our SGT-600, SGT-700, SGT-750, and SGT-800 gas turbines.
Our team combines deep technical expertise with an open and supportive atmosphere where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are encouraged. Colleagues help each other and work together to solve technical challenges.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Application
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 298984 not later than 2026-12-14
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.
We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

Do you want to be a part building the next generation of platforms within fintech? Do you have solid experience in backend development and Java, and enjoy taking technical ownership? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence architecture, integrations and scalable solutions in a growing tech company? Then the role as Senior Software Engineer to Yabie could be the right opportunity for you!
About Yabie
Yabie is a Swedish fintech company that has been developing cloud-based POS systems and payment solutions since 2017. By combining payments, point-of-sale systems, sales and other features into a single platform, Yabie helps businesses simplify their daily operations and run their businesses more efficiently. Yabie continues to develop its technology and organisation to create even better and more scalable solutions.
About the role as Senior Software Engineer
As a Senior Software Engineer at Yabie, you will become an important part of the backend team and take clear ownership of developing and maintaining the systems that power Yabie's platform. Part of the role also involves expanding Yabie's API capabilities, including APIs and MCP setup, so that more partners can integrate with their solution. You will work hands-on with Java and Spring Boot, building backend services, APIs and integrations that connect Yabie's platform with partners and external systems. Your work will involve everything from designing new solutions to improving existing integrations, with a strong focus on quality, scalability and maintainability.
The tech team consists of approximately 20 people with expertise in backend development, mobile development, QA and DevOps. You will join the backend team alongside nine other backend developers. You will work closely with both the product teams and other developers, with great opportunities to influence technical solutions and ways of working.
Your main responsibilities:
Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
Design and develop integrations between Yabie, partners and external systems.
Contribute to architecture and scalable technical solutions.
Troubleshoot, optimise and improve existing services.

About you
We are looking for someone with a post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Development or a similar field, alternatively equivalent professional experience. You have approximately five or more years of experience in backend development and have worked with Java and Spring Boot in a production environment. You have solid experience in API development, REST, integrations and databases, as well as an understanding of microservices and scalable systems. Experience with AWS is an advantage, as is working with API Gateways such as Kong.
As a person, you are self-driven, curious and enjoy taking ownership of the bigger picture. You like understanding how different systems connect and feel comfortable developing technical solutions independently rather than simply implementing predefined specifications. You enjoy collaborating with others and are happy to share your technical knowledge with the team.
Important for the position:
Approximately 5+ years of experience in backend development, including Java, Spring Boot, REST, integrations and API development.
Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, as well as AWS.
Understanding of microservices and software architecture.
Extensive experience with AI-assisted development and modern AI tools.
Fluent in English and preferably also Swedish, both spoken and written.

Additional qualifications that are considered a plus:
Experience with Kong.
A background in fintech or payment solutions.
Experience in data engineering or data modelling, and/or experience with Okta or a similar identity platform.

What Yabie offers
At Yabie, you will become part of a tech company where technology has a direct impact on customers' everyday operations. You will work with a platform used by approximately 10,000 businesses and have the opportunity to influence how the platform and its integrations evolve. Yabie actively embraces AI-assisted development and offers you great opportunities to influence both the technology and your own role.
Additional information
Start: By agreement.
Employment: Full-time.
Location: Stockholm.
Salary: By agreement.

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. 

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.
 
About the job
Ready to make a positive impact? We are glad to present this opportunity to join a great team at a highly innovative company as we are looking for a Key Account Manager. This is a role where you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and strengthening long-term partnerships with some of Alfa Laval's most important customers across Denmark and Sweden within the food and pharmaceutical industries.

You will serve as the customer's trusted advisor and main point of contact, coordinating closely with technical specialists, service teams, inside sales, and other stakeholders across the organization, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. The customers that you will serve are mainly pharma customers.
 
Your primary focus will be:
Proactive sales - developing existing strategic accounts by understanding customer needs.
Identifying new business opportunities and following up leads.
Coordination/meeting optimization with internal and external stakeholders.
 

Success in this role requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations and decision-making processes.

You will be part of a team of ten and have a key role in further contributing to our customers' and Alfa Lavals growth. You report to Tina Masini Tarp, a manager who aims to create a collaborative environment where people feel trusted, take ownership, and contribute to shared success.
 
Who are you
You are a commercially driven and customer-focused professional who enjoys building long-term relationships and creating value for customers. You actively engage and network with stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate customer needs into opportunities. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across functions and cultures. Most importantly, you are motivated by developing strategic partnerships and delivering sustainable business growth.
 
What you know
We are looking for you with experience within Key Account Management, Technical Sales, Business Development and/or Strategic Sales. You need the ability to understand technical solutions and connect them to customer value as well as being able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions and countries.
 
Requirement:
Experience working with larger industrial customers, preferably within pharma, food, beverage, dairy, or related industries.
Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills.
Experience with CRM systems and sales planning tools.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Food Technology, Process Engineering, or a related field.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English in addition to either Swedish or Danish (depending on your location)
Driving licence

 
For more information, please contact
Tina Masini Tarp, Market Area Manager, Food & Pharma at 
or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner 
We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.
We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Please send your application no later than December 10, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!
 
At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in or have an established presence in the area of Søborg, Denmark. 
 
Our commitment to integrity
We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.

Company description:
At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.
Job description:Shape competence development within high-voltage testing
 Do you want to play a key role in ensuring the right competencies are in place for safe, high-quality and efficient testing operations within our Testing organization? As Manager Training & Development, you will combine people leadership with competence development and support one of NKT's most important operational functions. This is an opportunity to work closely with operational teams, trainers and technical specialists while helping build the capabilities needed to support NKT's continued growth and the green transition.
  
 Develop people, training programs and competence frameworks
 As Manager Training & Development, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining a structured approach to competence assurance across NKT's Testing organization. The role combines strategic and operational responsibility for training and qualification processes with people management. A key part of the position is to manage, support and develop the Trainers team while ensuring the organization has the competence needed to deliver safe and high-quality testing operations. You will collaborate with operational teams, technical specialists, HR and other stakeholders to create effective training programs and long-term competence plans.
  
 Your responsibility will be to:
  Manage, support and develop the Trainers team
 Create and maintain methodologies and competence frameworks for Testing
 Define competence levels and qualification criteria for relevant roles
 Plan and coordinate training and qualification activities
 Follow up competence needs, risks and development initiatives across the organization
  
 
 The position is based in Karlskrona and reports to the Director Expertise & Support within Operations & Site Karlskrona. You will work closely with colleagues across the Testing organization, engineering functions, HR and external training providers.
  
 People-focused manager with a structured approach
 You are a manager who enjoys supporting others in their development and creating the conditions for teams to perform well. You build trust through clear communication, collaboration and consistency, while maintaining structure and a long-term perspective. As the role involves many stakeholders, you are comfortable bringing people together around shared goals and helping establish efficient ways of working. You value knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and creating an environment where people are supported in their development.
  
 You also have:
  Experience of managing, coaching or developing employees or teams
 Understanding of competence management and qualification processes
 Very good communication skills in Swedish and English
  
 
 It is an advantage if you also have:
  Technical education in electrical engineering, power engineering or equivalent experience
 Experience from testing, high-voltage engineering, laboratory operations or a related technical field
  
 
 Contribute to NKT's future competence and growth
 We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths — even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better every day work environment.
  
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop both your leadership and professional skills while collaborating with colleagues across the organization. Join Telavox as a Network Engineer - Platform & Technical Enablement
Are you a network engineer with solid routing fundamentals who also feels at home in a Linux shell? At Telavox, our infrastructure team is growing, and we’re looking for a Network Engineer to help scale and secure the backbone of our global communication services.
More and more of our network runs on open-source routing software on standard servers, managed as code, alongside traditional network gear. You’ll join a highly skilled, collaborative team that likes automation-first thinking and continuous learning. If you want hard problems with real impact and enjoy working across teams, this role is for you.
About the job
As a Network Engineer at Telavox, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and operating our core network infrastructure. That covers data center networking, edge PoPs, cloud native integrations, and infrastructure automation. You’ll work with experienced engineers who share a DevOps mindset and work with autonomy, quality, and speed.
Your day-to-day work may include:

Designing and implementing scalable network solutions, both on-prem and across distributed global environments

Building and operating Linux-based routing alongside our existing network platforms

Automating configuration, monitoring, and provisioning with tools like Ansible, Python, and Bash

Expanding and maintaining our international edge network of PoP sites

Managing our hybrid infrastructure and private cloud, with Kubernetes networking at the core

Supporting our infrastructure APIs so product teams can self-serve

Ensuring high availability and performance with OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN and WireGuard/IPsec

Collaborating across product and platform teams to turn complex requirements into practical, robust infrastructure

This role can be based in either our Malmö HQ or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You’re a systems thinker with deep networking expertise and a drive to simplify, automate, and scale. You’ve run production networks at scale and know Linux well enough to troubleshoot and build on it, whether you already route on Linux or want to go further in that direction. You’re structured in your approach but flexible in how you find solutions.
Key skills and experience we’re looking for:

Extensive experience designing and operating production-grade network environments

Solid working knowledge of Linux and Linux networking

Strong command of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), overlays (VXLAN, EVPN), and secure networking (WireGuard, IPsec)

Comfortable with automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash)

Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as NetBox, Prometheus, and Grafana

Good understanding of network segmentation, zero trust principles, and security practices for critical infrastructure

Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset; you enjoy sharing knowledge across team boundaries

Good to have:

Experience running routing or packet forwarding on Linux with open-source software

Experience with Juniper or similar carrier-grade platforms

Hands-on experience with hypervisor and container-based workloads, especially Kubernetes on-prem

Network or cloud certifications (JNCIE, CCNP, AWS, etc.)

 Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are.
We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English.
Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson at emil.nilsson@telavox.com

We’re looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role drives performance across paid media and direct marketing channels at Axel Arigato, making sure marketing investment delivers efficient, scalable growth. You’ll run continuous testing and optimization, turn performance data into clear actions, and ensure campaigns are running efficiently. You’ll work closely with E-commerce, Content and Product teams to improve results and shape channel strategy, measurement and execution.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
This role suits someone who is naturally numbers-driven, with a strong analytical mindset and is confident in the setup and execution behind a campaign. You read KPIs, margins, profit, and you move budgets where they’ll work hardest. You’re at home in ad platforms, tag managers, and product feeds, and you know how tracking, conversions, and catalogs connect. When something breaks, you dig in and fix it. You keep an eye on platform changes, especially with AI, and you test and adapt. You’re structured and proactive, and you collaborate well with tech teams, agencies, and colleagues across the business.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Your main responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Own and optimize performance across dedicated paid media and direct marketing channels, managing paid media budgets to hit revenue, profitability, and growth targets.

Track daily, weekly, and monthly performance, and turn the data into clear insights, actions, and reports.

Support the creation of in-platform tests roadmap to optimize the campaigns and run the testing roadmap across creatives, attribution, audiences, bidding, landing pages, etc.

Own tracking health across ad platforms, including pixels, tags, conversion setup, server-side tracking, and consent mode.

Own product feed quality and structure across Channable, Merchant Center, Google Ads and Meta, so catalog-based campaigns and AI-driven formats perform at their best.

Prepare data, feeds, and measurement for AI readiness, and stay on top of how AI is changing the platforms and campaigns.

Work with tech teams and agencies to quickly identify and fix tracking or data issues.

Keep on top of platform updates, industry trends, and competitor activity to spot new opportunities.

Collaborate with the rest of the digital marketing team, content, e-commerce, and product teams to improve campaign results.

ARE YOU THE ONE?
We seek people with most of the following:

A Bachelor’s or Graduate Degree in Marketing, Business, or a relevant field.

3+ years of experience in performance marketing, with a focus on revenue-driven growth, through Google and Meta Ads.

Proven experience interpreting KPIs, trends, margins, and profit.

Hands-on skills with GTM, pixels, product feeds, and measurement platforms, and comfort with the technical side of the platforms and AI changes.

A solid understanding of customer behavior and digital funnel optimization.

Confidence working cross-functionally and with other external stakeholders.

A curious, proactive mindset that stays ahead of new trends and technologies.

HERE'S HOW TO APPLY
If you want to join us and shape how Axel Arigato grows across paid channels, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply by submitting your CV in English. Please do not include a photo or date of birth with your application; our recruitment process is competency-based.
We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.
CONTRACT TYPE & START DATE
Contract type: Permanent. Full-time.
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.
Estimated starting date: As agreed
A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATO
Founded in Sweden in 2014 by Albin Johansson and Max Svärdh, Axel Arigato was born with a disruptive mindset, modernising and democratising the sneaker landscape through a blend of style, quality, community and a digital-first approach.
Grounded in Scandinavian minimalism and elevated with playful, intentional details, every piece is designed with care: crafted to move globally, worn with individuality.
What began online expanded into physical spaces built for energetic cultural exchange: stores and experiences where conversations, performances and unexpected activations dissolve the boundaries between brand and culture.
Today, AXEL ARIGATO continues to evolve with purpose via a people-powered approach. It shows up where culture happens: on streets, at events and across cities.
Built on curiosity. Driven by connection.
OUR VALUES: DROP
Diversity, Respect, Openness, and Passion are our values that we live and breathe. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

Do you want to continue creating a better life at home – and for yourself?
With us, you can feel at home in your work while continuing to grow and develop within IKEA. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, to explore new perspectives, and to learn from both successes and mistakes. We invite you to open new doors, build on your experience, and challenge yourself in new ways. As our Label Compliance Specialist, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and contribute in a new context.
Your next role
As a Label Compliance Specialist, you will help secure that local compliance information on products and packaging is managed accurately and efficiently across the home furnishing and accessories range. You will work across Range Areas and with different stakeholders to turn compliance requirements into information that can be implemented and maintained throughout the range.
A big part of the role is about creating structure in a complex information landscape. You will combine attention to detail with collaboration, helping the organisation manage changes while continuously improving how we work with compliance information.
On a typical working day, you will:
Manage and administer local compliance information labels and other relevant compliance information for the saleable range.
Plan and coordinate the deployment of local compliance information together with relevant stakeholders, keeping timelines and deliveries on track.
Execute and follow up the implementation of new and updated compliance-information requirements on products and packaging.
Manage label data such as headings, values, compliance texts and symbols.
Contribute to digital development and process improvements by bringing business needs into solutions and ways of working.
Analyse label compliance deviations and contribute to mitigation and improvement actions.
Identify and address gaps in label documentation.
Build competence across the organisation by sharing knowledge and developing recommended ways of working for label management.

What we’d like you to bring to the table
To succeed in this role, we believe you enjoy bringing structure and clarity to detailed information while keeping sight of the bigger picture. You are curious, analytical and comfortable collaborating across functions and organisations. Accuracy and data quality matter to you, and you enjoy learning, improving and sharing your knowledge with others.
The role as Label Compliance Specialist requires you to have:
Experience working with product documentation, legal requirements, compliance information or digital products.
Experience working in cross-functional projects or assignments.
Strong analytical skills together with a structured and organised way of working.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage information accurately.
The ability to plan, monitor and follow up activities and deliveries.
The ability to communicate complex information in a clear and simple way and build relationships across functions.
Good knowledge or experience of digital tools and information management.

It’s a plus if you also:
Have experience working with label management or product information requirements.
Have worked in a global retail organisation or across a complex value chain.
Have experience coaching, educating or sharing working methods with others.

Be yourself, a Label Compliance Specialist, and more!

System Engineer
Electrical System Engineer – Electrical Installation
A Snapshot of Your Day
As an Electrical Engineer within our Medium Gas Turbine segment, you will work with customer-specific electrical design and complete electrical documentation for customer projects worldwide. Within the Electrical Installation team, you will focus on the overall installation design, including cables, cable trays, junction boxes, and routing. Depending on your experience level, you will either work closely with more senior colleagues or take a leading role in electrical design within customer order projects. You will collaborate with assembly, site, subcontractors, purchasing, and the sales organization. As part of the projects, you will also spend time in the workshop to support the projects throughout the complete assembly phase. We offer an environment where learning, collaboration, and continuous development are encouraged, and where responsibilities grow with your experience.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Are you a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a particular interest in breast and melanoma surgery? 
Are you looking for an opportunity to develop further within specialised cancer surgery while working in a multidisciplinary and academically active environment?
We are currently recruiting a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a strong professional interest in breast and melanoma surgery for a permanent position at a major university hospital in southwestern Sweden.
The position offers the opportunity to combine specialised clinical work with multidisciplinary cancer care, professional development, teaching and research in a highly specialised hospital environment.
About the position
Your primary focus will be the care and surgical treatment of patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma.
The role includes both outpatient care and day surgery, and you will be involved in the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients.
The work is characterised by close multidisciplinary and multiprofessional collaboration, where surgeons work together with other specialists and healthcare professionals throughout the patient's treatment pathway.
Most of the work is carried out during daytime hours. Depending on your individual competence and previous experience, participation in general surgical on-call duties may also be included.
Breast and melanoma surgery
The position is particularly suited to a general surgeon who already has clinical experience within breast surgery, melanoma surgery or related oncological surgery and wishes to continue developing within this field.
You will work with patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma in a specialised surgical environment that combines clinical care with continuous development.
The broader surgical organisation also includes areas such as upper gastrointestinal surgery, endocrine and sarcoma surgery, as well as acute and trauma surgery.
A university hospital environment
The hospital offers an environment where specialised healthcare, education, clinical development and research are closely connected.
The breast and melanoma surgery field is research-intensive, and teaching and continuous development are natural parts of the position.
For a surgeon who wants to combine clinical expertise with continued academic and professional development, this provides an opportunity to build a long-term career within a large Swedish university hospital.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery who has a particular interest and relevant experience in breast and melanoma surgery.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary setting and are comfortable taking responsibility while contributing to the continued development of the department.
You value close collaboration with colleagues from different professions and specialties and have a patient-centred approach to your work.
Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has relevant clinical experience
Has experience and a strong professional interest in breast surgery, melanoma surgery and/or related oncological surgery
Is comfortable managing patients throughout different stages of the surgical care pathway
Enjoys working in multidisciplinary and multiprofessional teams
Has a strong sense of responsibility and an interest in clinical development
Has good communication and collaboration skills
Has good English language skills
Is strongly motivated to learn Swedish and establish a long-term career in Sweden

For candidates who do not yet speak Swedish, language training is provided as part of the recruitment process.
What the hospital offers
You will have the opportunity to:
Work within specialised breast and melanoma surgery

Become part of an established multidisciplinary cancer care environment
Participate in teaching and continuous clinical development
Work in a research-intensive university hospital environment
Collaborate with experienced specialists across different medical and surgical disciplines

jobs.occupation: Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)
jobs.description:
Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)
Reference number PAR 2026/894
The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.
The Department of Health and Care Sciences conducts education and research focusing on healthcare, health and people's living conditions. We educate nurses, radiographers, specialist nurses and midwives, with the aim of meeting society's need for skilled and committed healthcare professionals.
Research at the Department covers a wide range of areas, with a shared foundation in person-centred and evidence-based care. We are nationally and internationally recognised as a leader in person-centred care, an approach that underpins our education, research and collaboration with healthcare providers.
The Department is part of Sahlgrenska Academy at the University of Gothenburg and is located at Campus Medicinareberget, close to Sahlgrenska University Hospital. This provides an environment characterised by interprofessional collaboration, strong links to clinical practice and high academic standards. The Department has approximately 1,200 students enrolled in first- and second-cycle programmes leading to professional qualifications in healthcare.
We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and with different experiences and perspectives. We value diversity and actively promote an inclusive and equal working environment where all employees have opportunities to thrive and develop. To support a healthy work-life balance, we offer flexible working arrangements.
The University of Gothenburg is a Swedish government agency, which means that employees benefit from favourable employment conditions, generous annual leave and an occupational pension scheme.
Read more about working at the University of Gothenburg on our website: Work at the University of Gothenburg
We are looking for a colleague with a strong interest in teaching and a commitment to course development and the advancement of teaching and learning. The successful applicant should be highly motivated to share knowledge with students and demonstrate a strong commitment to educational development.
The position will primarily be based in the Section for Diagnostics and Care in Acute and Critical Conditions / Reproductive and Perinatal Health. Teaching will mainly take place within the Midwifery Programme. Depending on operational needs, duties may also involve collaboration with other sections within the Department.
Subject area 
Reproductive and perinatal health
Subject area description 
Reproductive and perinatal health is grounded in a humanistic view of the person and generates knowledge about human reproduction and its processes. This encompasses sexuality, fertility, abortion, contraception, pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, the neonatal period, parenthood and menopause.    
Duties 
Teaching will primarily focus on subject-specific areas related to the midwifery profession and its core competencies: person-centred care, safe care, health informatics, teamwork, evidence-based care, leadership, interprofessional learning and pedagogy.
The duties include teaching and assessment, course coordination, supervision of degree projects and supervision of students during clinical placements. 
The position primarily involves planning and teaching at second-cycle level, keeping up to date with developments in relevant subject areas, the professional role of the midwife, person-centred leadership and clinically integrated learning. The duties also include teaching and supervision at first-cycle level, as well as course coordination at both first- and second-cycle levels.
As course coordinator, responsibilities include developing and coordinating learning outcomes, learning activities, assessment methods and assessment criteria in relation to course content, objectives and current research in higher education pedagogy. Acting as a university liaison for students undertaking clinical placements is an important part of the position. The role also involves ensuring the quality of education through validated evaluation methods. Some teaching of clinical skills is also included.
Administrative duties related to educational activities constitute a significant part of the role. Other duties may also be assigned, and the responsibilities associated with the position may change over time.
The position also involves actively contributing to the achievement of the Department's objectives and operational plan. This includes supporting the development of the academic environment within the section's Complete Academic Environment (KAM). In addition, all staff members are expected to participate in scheduled departmental meetings and joint activities.
The successful candidate will teach in both Swedish and English.
See more info on the University of Gothenburgs homepage job opportunities.

jobs.description:
If you're passionate about data, code, and AI, take pride in getting the numbers right, and want to build the data and AI platform behind a fast-growing beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your application today!
About the role
Our client is a Stockholm-based global beauty brand. They develop premium, high-performing products at accessible price points, defined by quality and a Scandinavian aesthetic. Driven by an entrepreneurial and creative culture, they combine modern brand storytelling with operational excellence.
Every decision across their organisation, from which shades to restock to which campaigns to scale or markets to expand into, starts with data. Their modern data platform unifies e-commerce, advertising, and retail metrics, while custom AI assistants empower teams to interact with that data directly.
As a Data & AI Engineer, you will join their Tech team and report directly to the CTO. You will collaborate closely with marketing, finance, and operations to build and run the pipelines, services, and AI tooling powering company-wide analytics. From modelling sales data in Dataform to deploying an MCP server that lets AI assistants query BigQuery, you will ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, documented, and timely figures.
This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or with a couple of years of experience who writes solid SQL, values clean and well-tested code, builds with AI daily, and wants ownership of production systems at a rapidly scaling brand.
Work tasks
You will build and maintain data pipelines, models, and AI-driven services to support business reporting, analytics, and data-informed decisions across the company:
Build and maintain data models in Dataform and BigQuery (incremental models, assertions, and cost-aware partitioning/clustering).  
Ingest data from source systems (e-commerce, advertising platforms, ERP, and retail partners) into BigQuery with scheduling, alerting, and backfills.  
Write and deploy Python or TypeScript services on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) with proper IAM, secrets management, and logging.  
Collaborate with marketing, finance, and operations to translate ambiguous business questions into precise data models and queries.  
Build, deploy, and maintain MCP servers on Cloud Run to connect AI assistants to internal data, applying least-privilege IAM and monitoring.  
Maintain the semantic layer for AI assistants (defining metrics once, writing metadata and catalog documentation, and solving data discrepancies at the source).  
Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as your default development workflow-writing clear task specs, critically reviewing outputs, and shipping tested code via CI/CD.  
Support internal teams in expanding their AI workflows and setting up custom assistants.

We are looking for
A university degree (BSc or MSc) in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, information systems, or an equivalent field. A focus on data science is a strong plus.
2–4 years of experience in big data and data modeling — internships, thesis work, and serious side projects count.
Solid SQL – joins, window functions, data grain and incremental models.
Hands-on coding in Python or TypeScript; you can write, test and debug a small service on your own.
Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud.
An AI-native way of working – you use coding agents daily and know when not to trust their output.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain what you built, and why, to non-technical colleagues.
Curiosity, a quick learning curve and comfort in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent Swedish and English.

It is meritorious if you have
Production experience with BigQuery, and with Dataform or dbt.
Experience with dimensional modelling and data quality testing.
An understanding of containers, service accounts, least-privilege access and basic networking.
Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer brands.
Experience building or integrating LLM-based tooling – MCP, function calling or agents. Side projects count.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stress tolerant
Goal oriented
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.description:
Job ID: 5898
 
Senior Risk Expertfor for Risk Materiality (permanent position)
 
Would you like to play a key role in strengthening how Nordea identifies, assesses and explains ESG risks across our risk profile? We are looking for a senior risk expert who can take ownership of an important risk materiality process, connecting ESG risk drivers, transmission channels, heatmaps and expert judgement into clear and decision-useful input for risk management and governance.
 
About our team
 
Meet the Group Credit Risk team. Our role is to ensure that Nordea has a strong, well-documented and forward-looking understanding of material risks. This includes how ESG risk drivers may affect Nordea’s customers, industries, geographies, value chains and risk profile over different time horizons.
 
As the Senior Risk Expert for Risk Materiality, you’ll play a valuable role in owning and further developing the process for ESG risk identification and materiality assessment. You will ensure that ESG risks are properly identified in Nordea’s Common Risk Taxonomy and materiality assessment, identify and document transmission channels, develop and challenge ESG heatmaps, and ensure that outputs are clear, robust and useful for risk areas, governance forums and senior decision-makers. The role requires a strong combination of risk management expertise, ESG risk understanding, analytical judgement, stakeholder management and documentation discipline. You will work closely with subject matter experts and risk colleagues across Nordea to ensure that ESG risks are identified and assessed in a consistent, transparent and well-governed way. 
 
Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
 
Main responsibilities in this role:
Own and develop the risk identification process for ESG risks, including ESG in risk taxonomy and materiality assessment, transmission channel framework and heatmap methodology.
Translate complex ESG risk drivers into clear risk narratives, explaining how environmental, social and governance factors may transmit into Nordea’s risk taxonomy.
Coordinate and challenge expert input across risk areas and stakeholders, facilitating alignment on relevant ESG risks, time horizons, industries, geographies, assumptions and methodological choices.
Secure high-quality documentation and governance, including methodology updates, annual reviews, expert judgements, deviations, assumptions and outputs that can be used in materiality assessment and risk governance.
Prepare decision material for Senior Stakeholders incl. Credit Risk Sub-Committee.

 
Who you are
 
This is the right role for you if you:
Have strong understanding of ESG risk drivers — including climate-related, nature-related, social and governance factors — and can explain how these may affect a bank’s customers, portfolios, value chains and overall risk profile.
Can own and drive a structured risk process across units, ensuring clear planning, stakeholder involvement, timely delivery, strong documentation and continuous improvement.
Have strong analytical skills and sound judgement, including the ability to work with heatmaps, scoring logic, vulnerability assessments, time horizons, data limitations and expert-based assumptions.
Are able to translate complex methodology into clear communication, including narratives, executive summaries and decision-useful material for risk areas, governance forums and senior stakeholders.
Have excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to facilitate discussions, challenge constructively and build alignment across different levels of the organisation and across the value chain.
Bring high integrity, ownership and a solution-oriented mindset, with the courage to challenge assumptions and the drive to ensure that the process remains robust, transparent and fit for purpose.

 
Your background and skills include:
A degree in economics, finance, sustainability, risk management, mathematics, data science, business administration or another relevant field.
Solid experience from risk management, ESG risk, sustainability risk, credit risk, enterprise risk management, regulatory risk, financial services or consulting.
Experience with risk identification, materiality assessment, risk taxonomies, methodology ownership, heatmaps, scoring frameworks or similar structured assessment processes.
Good understanding of ESG-related regulatory and supervisory expectations, for example from ECB, EBA, CSRD/ESRS, NGFS, BCBS or similar frameworks.
Experience in working with complex information, external sources, data, expert judgement and methodological assumptions, and turning this into clear conclusions and documentation.
Strong spoken and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical or complex risk topics in a clear and practical way.
Experience with Excel-based tools, data mapping, documentation, quality assurance or process governance is an advantage.

 
If this sounds like you, get in touch!
 
Next steps
 
Submit your application no later than 10/12/2026. 

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis: Minimizing Spatial Averaging Uncertainty in Heat Pump Sound
jobs.description:
Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". 

Job Description
Background & Objective
In heat pump sound power declarations under ISO 3741 (direct method) and EN 12102-1, spatial averaging uncertainty of sound pressure is the dominating contributor to overall measurement reproducibility. In Bosch’s reverberation test chamber (chamber volume approximately 250 cubic meters), low modal density below the Schroeder frequency (around 255 Hz) and discrete compressor tones sometimes cause high spatial variance across stationary microphones in low-to-mid frequency region (50 – 1500 Hz).
The primary objective of this Master thesis is to minimize spatial averaging uncertainty (in aforementioned frequency range) in said chamber by investigating and optimizing two complementary physical levers:
Active Diffusion (w. a rotating diffuser): Maximizing dynamic mode-mixing while preventing aerodynamic blade / structural self-noise and cyclic averaging errors.
Low-Frequency Modal Absorption: Increasing modal bandwidth to smooth out spatial variance while respecting ISO 3741 reverberation limits (T60 at least > what-standard-requires seconds)

Scope of Work
Diffuser Self-Noise vs. Speed Envelope: Map chamber background noise versus vane rotational speed (0 to 10 RPM, tip speed up to 2.0 m/s) to determine the safe operational limit where aerodynamic wind noise OR structural noise does not corrupt heat pump measurements.
Active Diffusion & Integration Time: Quantify spatial variance reduction for pure tones and compressor harmonics; validate the rule of averaging time to integer multiples of full vane revolutions.
Microphone Array Optimization: Determine the minimum number of stationary microphones (such as 6, 12, or higher) and required spacing (minimum distance greater than half wavelength) needed to reliably achieve Grade 1 precision accuracy.
Low-Frequency Absorption Assessment: Develop and validate targeted absorption and damping treatments to the chamber to increase the modal overlap at frequencies<315 Hz, while ensuring the chamber absorption satisfies ISO 3741 criteria.

Key Deliverables
Diffuser Operating Envelope & Self-Noise Guideline: Recommendations on vane RPM limits, tip speed thresholds, revolution-locked integration rules and self-noise-reducing measures.
Optimized Microphone Array Setup/Configuration: Quantified trade-off between active diffusion, absorption, and the required microphone count.
Low-Frequency Absorption Evaluation Report: Assessment of modal damping at f<315 Hz, on spatial standard deviation and chamber compliance.
Master’s Thesis Report & Defense Presentation: Academic thesis report and an internal presentation of practical laboratory recommendations.

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Enrolled in an M.Sc. program in Acoustics, Sound & Vibration, Mechanical Engineering, or Applied Physics.
Strong interest in hands-on acoustic laboratory testing, room acoustics, and experimental signal processing.
Basic experience with acoustic acquisition software (such as HEAD acoustics ArtemiS SUITE) and data scripting (MATLAB or Python) is a plus.
Good communication skills in English.

Additional Information
Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.

Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch
